mcacapitals.dialogue.crabby.call.evening: I thought %79$s already paid the tax collector. Apparently once wasn't enough.
Ask %27$s. %79$s was there when it happened.
They say the court's still in mourning over %21$s.
Word is %13$s was seen leaving %2$s in the night.
I heard %7$s hasn't been seen at court in days.
Is it true, what they're saying about %2$s?
They say the %66$s is drafting new writs. As if we needed more of those.
There's %119$s dukes and %120$s lords at court now, and still nothing gets done. Impressive, really.
This well water tastes off again. Someone ought to fix it instead of arguing about it.
Have you fixed that fence yet, or is the goat still winning?
You look tired.
I dreamt the chickens were plotting against me.
I traded my good boots for a sack of turnips.
The baker swears his bread cures a bad back. He ought to focus on making decent bread first.
I bet you an emerald the rain holds off till dusk.
They say if the well runs dry twice in one year, someone in the village dies.
I swear that cat's been following me since market day.
I lost another chicken to that fox last night.
I haven't slept properly in a week.
I tried to haggle with the butcher and lost badly.
I think my neighbor's chicken is cursed.
The bread didn't rise this morning. Bad omen, my mother always said.
The armorer's been hammering since before sunrise. Some of us were trying to sleep.
The fisherman hasn't caught a thing in days. At some point he has to admit he's the problem.
There was a scuffle near the smithy last night.
The butcher's asking twice what he did last month. He can keep it.
The nitwit tried to sell me a cracked bowl for full price.
I still owe the leatherworker for those boots from spring.
The children have been playing at knights again all morning.
The children keep asking to learn the bow.
Someone's been letting their chickens wander into my garden again. I'm about done asking nicely.
I tried carrying too many eggs at once and, well, you can guess.
I heard %69$s brought word from %155$s this morning.
They say %7$s held court until well after dark. No wonder everyone came out looking miserable.
They say %7$s has been asking questions about the village.
They say relations with %155$s are improving.
Heard we're friendly with %155$s now.
Someone said an envoy from %155$s arrived today.
One of the knights nearly knocked me into the mud this morning. Fine manners on that lot.
Think %11$s will make a good ruler someday?
Someone stole my washing off the line.
I found three emeralds under a floorboard yesterday.
Someone's been taking apples from my tree.
Birds don't leave footprints.
That dog stole my sausage right out of my hand.
My door's started making that noise again.
The weaponsmith's made a new sword.
What's the point of a new sword if nobody uses it?
There aren't as many people at the inn lately. Maybe they finally got tired of the noise.
Careful. The walls have ears.
If the Crown wants loyalty, it should start with better bread.
I wonder what %8$s %7$s thinks when looking over all this.
The oldest stones in town have seen more rulers than we ever will.
Every great house began with someone standing in a village square.
I miss when this place was small enough to know every face.
The children keep growing faster than the houses.
I saw three new faces near the inn today.
The road into %2$s has been busier than usual. Mostly with people who don't know where they're going.
We have %3$s residents, but somehow only one good gossip spot.
If %2$s keeps growing, we'll need another well.
The capital has enough gossip to feed %3$s people.
I counted %3$s residents, and half of them were in my way. The other half were probably about to be.
The road dust gets everywhere this time of day. Another fine feature of capital life.
I hope my bed is still where I left it.
I heard it from the baker, who heard it from the guard.
That's how gossip starts, and I refuse to be blamed again.
I heard something strange earlier, but I didn't check.
Don't tell anyone I said that.
No, I will not explain.
I'm telling you, the chicken knows something.
I'm not superstitious. I'm experienced.
The cats near the square are getting awfully organized.
Someone said the chicken should rule %2$s.
There are chickens everywhere near the market again. Nobody seems interested in doing anything about it.
